patterns.prevention:
• Contact centres at the 6-week and 12-week marks to confirm satisfaction and identify budget or scheduling concerns before they escalate to cancellation.

• Review session timing options with new centres during onboarding and proactively offer schedule adjustments if initial slots aren't working.

• Develop a simple "value proposition" document highlighting the cost and resource efficiency of outsourcing versus running programs in-house to share during renewal conversations.

• Set calendar reminders at month 2 and month 4 of each contract to check in on program fit and lock in term commitments before centres plan alternative providers.
